status: offline unified controller implemented; hardware gate remains closed
user_model_choice: No measured Dex1 data; use official model and mass sensitivity study
numeric_fix: Engine-visible affine PD bias with implicitfast; continuous PD equality regression passed; use 1ms and verify at 0.5ms
model_fix: Retain mode5 rev1.0 body, replace fused rubber-hand mass with bare wrist inertia and official mode15 Dex1 subtree. Assumed mount, 0.364946 kg/hand, coupled finger sliders.
standing_fix: Bounded position/velocity/integral outer loop feeding official policy velocity command; reliable world pose required.
load_fix: Known-mass FK CoM compensation plus bounded IMU waist trim; 0.2rad bound, 0.3rad/s and 0.6rad/s^2 waist limits.
controller_features: Single servo owner composes slots0..28 and31/33; inactive29/30/32/34 remain disabled.
Integrated preopen then ACTIVE then UPPER_HOLD while lower policy continues.
Operator release/input timeout/camera or recording failure holds upper setpoints, retains body gains.
Policy worker uses single-slot latest-input mailbox; servo performs no inference.
Recording uses bounded queue, records pre-submit state and only successful simulation submissions.
Lower-body faults and failed submissions latch without claiming a zero-gain stop can balance the robot.
Leg targets clipped to model bounds with raw policy targets and clipped indices retained.
No live DDS publisher, service/FSM switch, robot execution or new LeRobot export introduced.
remaining: Proprioceptive flat-ground stance odometry fails 180s global drift gate (1.125m); reliable external/base localization or a validated non-stepping stance policy is required before hardware integration.
Mode15 Dex1 mount on mode5 body and real wrist camera/bracket inertia unmeasured.
Motor-to-slider affine simulation mapping is not a calibrated Dex1 transmission.
Simulated finger drive and ideal initial pose do not verify physical preopen, contact force or startup authority transfer.
Real Quest/camera concurrency, hardware exclusive DDS ownership and independent body-fault stop remain unvalidated.

regression.note: Full 152-test suite passed (151 pass, 1 skip); subsequent export whitelist addition validated by the focused recording suite.
